findings.issue: The header now re-reads the invoice from the store after sendInvoice resolves, but still seeds its first render from the detail-page fetch. Correct today because the fetch and the store agree at mount; a future change that lets the store move first would show one stale frame.
findings.status: non-blocking; documented in the code comment + fix.json reactivity_note
findings.hardening_followup: Optional: have the detail page subscribe to the store row directly and drop the one-off fetch. Not done now to avoid scope creep (the fetch also feeds the activity panel).

summary: Real root-cause fix, not a symptom mask. (1) InvoiceStatusBadge renders from props.status instead of a mount-time copy, so it cannot go stale by construction; (2) InvoiceDetailHeader re-reads the store row after Send rather than special-casing the sent state. No swallowed exceptions, suppressed logs or disabled tests; no test-targeting branch. No security/perf concern. Approve.
